summary: Specifies a minimal YANG data model for TCP on devices managed through network management protocols. It defines a container for all TCP connections and reusable groupings for authentication parameters, which other models can import when they need to configure TCP.

eli5.summary: TCP is how computers keep a steady conversation going. This gives a simple standard list of the knobs and dials on that conversation so management software can see and set them.

questions: how to configure tcp authentication with yang
